deskyard computer list: list the computers you can see

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] computer list [--json]

Lists the computers your account can see on the server, with their state, your
access level, image and who is viewing. Administrators see every computer, and
the containers the server can't match (conflicts) on stderr.

Options:
  --json               print JSON instead of text
  --server NAME        the server to manage (see `deskyard server list`);
                       default: the server -c SERVER/COMPUTER names, else the
                       default server

Prints: a table NAME STATE ACCESS IMAGE VIEWERS; with --json the API's answer
  {computers:[Computer],conflicts:[Conflict]} (see the server's API
  reference)

Examples:
  deskyard computer list
  deskyard computer list --json

Where: on this machine, talking to the server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
